senses.gloss:
जूत a. [जू-क्त] (At the end of comp.)
—1 Impelled, urged, pressed.
—2 Ved. Gone.
—3 Drawn.
—4 Given.

जूतिः f.
—1 Going on, proceeding, moving; जूतिमिच्छथ चेत्तूर्णम् … … Bk. 7. 69.
—2 Quickness, speed.
—3 Uninterrupted flow or motion.
—4 Impulse, incitement, instigation.
—5 Inclination, propensity, tendency.
—6 N. of the author of Rv. 10. 136. 1.
—7 Concentration of mind … … जूतिः स्मृतिः संकल्पः क्रतुरसुः कामो
 वश इति Ait. Up. 5. 2.
